systems.title: Real problems, solved with AI.
systems.lead: Three documented systems, from problem to solution.

items.name: X9 Agent
items.problem: Managers can't tell whether clients in dozens of WhatsApp groups are being served or ignored.
solution: Monitors the groups Monday to Friday and checks that real service happened.
Runs twice a day (5 pm and 6 pm) and flags who hasn't moved.
Logs everything to a database and sends a weekly report.

items.name: QA Agent
items.summary: A meta-agent that tests other agents
items.problem: Every prompt change needs a manual testing cycle to make sure nothing broke.
solution: A generator agent creates a battery of test scenarios.
A simulator agent talks to the agent under test like a real customer.
A judge agent reviews everything, scores it from 0 to 100 and flags error patterns.

items.name: VSL Optimizer
items.problem: VSL (video sales letter) briefs are hard to evaluate and often lead to underperforming campaigns.
solution: A pipeline of 6 specialized LLMs, each following a copywriting framework.
A 0 to 10 score for each block: lead, story and offer.
A diagnosis of weak points and a new, ready-to-use version of the brief.

items.name: Online store
items.description: A complete e-commerce with card payments, login, an orders dashboard and confirmation emails.
items.stack: Next.js · TypeScript · Prisma · PostgreSQL · Stripe · Clerk

items.name: Voice agent
items.description: A voice receptionist that books, reschedules and cancels appointments, and never confirms a taken slot.
items.stack: Python · FastAPI · LiveKit · Whisper · tool calling · Docker

items.name: Automated newsletter
items.description: Collects news every day, summarizes it with AI and emails it, with confirmation and one-click unsubscribe.

process.title: From problem to a running system.

steps.title: Understand the problem
steps.text: Before any tool, the current process is mapped: where there is rework, delay or a lack of visibility.

steps.title: Design the solution
steps.text: Flow, data and integrations are designed end to end, with clear rules and points for human review.

steps.title: Build, measure, evolve
steps.text: The system goes live with metrics and reports. Based on the numbers, it evolves in versions.

about.title: Technology that solves business problems.
paragraphs: Vertix Labs is a technology studio that builds artificial intelligence, automation and custom software solutions for businesses.
The challenge: manual processes, disconnected systems and a lack of visibility cost time and opportunities in sales, support and operations.
The approach: understand the process, design the flow and build systems that run on their own, with metrics to improve with every version.

items.question: What is Vertix Labs?
items.answer: A technology studio that builds artificial intelligence, automation and custom software for sales, support and operations.

items.question: Which technologies are used?
items.answer: In the current systems: LLMs, LangChain, multi-agent orchestration, PostgreSQL and n8n. In the projects in progress: TypeScript, Next.js, Python, FastAPI, Prisma, Docker and more. The Stack section has the full list.

items.question: Can I see the code or documentation?
items.answer: Yes. The X9 and QA Agent projects have a repository and documentation on GitHub.

items.question: How do I get in touch?
items.answer: By email. Describe the problem in a few lines and the conversation starts from there.
